title: EtherFi Borrowing Market (Optimism, Aave V4 Cash Spoke) — public borrow gated, RWA feeds relay/Chainlink; E-U $0
closed_reasons: EtherFiSpokeInstance.borrow requires isEtherFiSafe(onBehalfOf); only the factory admin (ETHERFI_SAFE_FACTORY_ADMIN_ROLE) can create a Cash Safe, so an unprivileged caller can never satisfy the gate (fork-proven: revert OnlyEtherFiSafe 0xe883803e)
the only active position manager on the Spoke is the LendGateway (single UpdatePositionManager event ever); its borrow/withdraw/supply are onlyDriver (revert OnlyDriver 0xdf95dcac)
the CashModule signed-borrow path requires an owner-quorum EIP-191 signature and pays the borrowed funds to the Safe, never the caller

RWA feeds are OracleSinkPriceFeed (LayerZero-relayed from the mainnet PriceRelay, sink peer-gated via OnlyPeer) / ChainlinkPriceFeed (Chainlink aggregator) / ERC4626RatePriceFeed (issuer vault) — no OP-DEX-spot source exists (feed has no slot0())
liquidationCall requires healthFactor < 1e18; every RWA-collateralised Safe reads HF >> 1 (fork-proven revert HealthFactorNotBelowThreshold 0x930bb771)

Spoke.supply is permissionless (self is always a position manager) but non-extractive: Hub.add requires balanceOf(hub) >= liquidity and credits shares against a stored addedShares/liquidity index, so donations cannot inflate the share price
the Hub's second spoke is a TreasurySpokeInstance whose supply/withdraw/transfer are onlyOwner

caveats: USD totals use the protocol's own 8-decimal oracle prices; DefiLlama differs slightly
scope is the public-borrow path + RWA feeds + liquidations; the broader ether.fi Cash multi-sig/card surface was only spot-checked
7-day rateMaxStaleness on RWA feeds is a liveness/bad-debt risk (a stalled relay reverts the reserve), not attacker-triggerable profit

Spoke/Hub/LendGateway/OracleSink/DataProvider are upgradeable behind the ether.fi 24h timelock; the invariant 'no other position manager' and the borrow override depend on privileged roles (P risk, not counted)
fork block is a moving target; gate and feed structure are stable, price/debt numbers are point-in-time
the ether.fi Liquid AtomicQueue (Ethereum, 2026-09-11) is a different, prior-covered component (ZH1 C-07) and was not re-audited
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 from the ether.fi Cash Aave V4 instance on Optimism: public borrow is contract-gated to ether.fi Cash Safes (OnlyEtherFiSafe), the only position manager's borrow is driver-only (OnlyDriver), the RWA price feeds are LayerZero-relayed/Chainlink (no OP-DEX spot manipulation), and no RWA-collateralised position is liquidatable (HF >> 1).
